It's pinned as the original reads it, a file with no byte damaged: count, every position from two before the start to one past the end, every key by key and by rank, the walk from the start in full, and on each clone an iterator from every position and from every key, by its first entry, how many it gives, and the null. Left out, as the port answers them otherwise (SCRIPT-FORMAT.md section 10, tests/port-differs): an iterator from the keys k34, k35, k355, k36, k37, k38, k39, k395, k40, z of the map clone, whose places are past its count; and from the keys k34, k35, k355, k36, k37, k38, k39, k395, k40, z of the set clone, whose places are past its count.
